data.narrative:
Satellogic is a Space & Aerospace company at the public stage with $262M in total capital raised. The valuation analysis relies on a comparable-company universe of 4 same-sector, same-stage peers: Rocket Lab ($40.0B), Planet Labs ($7.6B), Firefly Aerospace ($2.9B), and Astroscale ($840M).

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach, as the target's revenue is not available, precluding a public-comparable P/S multiple application. The median valuation across the 4-peer set is $5.2B, with a range spanning $840M to $40.0B. This wide dispersion reflects material heterogeneity within the public space-tech cohort—driven by differences in operational maturity, addressable market focus, and capital efficiency. The sector's public P/S median sits at 26.4x across 6 tickers, though this metric cannot be applied without disclosed revenue.

Analysis supports a valuation range of $4.4B (low) to $6.0B (high), centered on a $5.2B median. Key uncertainties include the target's revenue trajectory and profitability path relative to peer benchmarks, as well as market-dependent repricing risk common to early-stage aerospace equities. The single-method reliance reflects limited applicability of alternative valuation frameworks given data constraints.
